relevance_note: The paper describes three individual males with LAMP2 microdeletions: "Here, we report three individuals with Danon disease who carry large genomic deletions involving the LAMP2 gene."
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand (no tables in the paper); the JSON was assembled with a short Python script from my own reading, and every span was checked verbatim against the Markdown by script. Labels: the paper uses 'Case-1/Case-2/Case-3' most often (subject IDs 0014, 00732, 0013 appear in headings and figure legends). Relatives: Case-2's 'available family members' (pedigree only in Figure 3D, count and relationships not given in text) were tested by Southern blot and western blot and lacked the deletion; Case-3 was compared with 'a control individual from the family of Case-2'. Because the text never says how many relatives or which relations, no relative rows were created (no individual could be identified without inventing people). Inheritance for Case-2 left 'not reported': the paper calls the deletion de novo ('consistent with a de novo mutation') but never states that both parents were tested; the testing statement is recorded in parental_testing_statement. Case-3: no parental DNA available. Variant strings: no HGVS given. Case-1 is a ~34.4kb deletion of the 5'UTR and exon-1 (breakpoints ~25.5kb upstream and ~8.9kb downstream of the start codon); Case-2 and Case-3 deletions remove intron-3 part/exons-4–10/part of 3'UTR. Size contradiction for Case-2: the abstract says Case-2 has a 64kb and Case-3 a 58Kb deletion ('respectively'), but Figure 3C legend characterises 'the ∼58kb microdeletion' in index case 00732 (Case-2); breakpoints given (~14kb and ~72kb for Case-2; ~14kb and ~78kb for Case-3) imply ~58kb and ~64kb. Because of this, variant_original_string for Case-2 and Case-3 is the exon-level description from each person's own molecular section, not the abstract's sizes. Also the abstract says the Case-2/-3 breakpoints map to 'a MIRb and (TA)_n simple repeats', while the results assign (TA)n/MER21B to Case-2 and MIRb/LIMA4A to Case-3. Breakpoint positions relative to the start codon are not genomic coordinates, so genomic_coordinates_as_stated is null. Transcript ENST00000371345 is printed in the Case-1 and Case-2 molecular sections only; Methods also name 'NM_013995' as the reference genomic DNA sequence for all, which was not assigned to anyone. Zygosity left 'not reported' (hemizygosity is mentioned only as a general statement about X-linked genes in males). Pathogenicity left 'not reported' (no per-variant classification; Case-1's deletion is called 'novel'). Case-2 onset recorded as age at first presentation (12 years, GI problems); age at diagnosis not stated explicitly (diagnosis changed after LAMP-2 analysis in the paragraph starting 'At 17 years of age'), so left not reported. Age at death not stated (MRI at 21 years, death 'Two months later'), so deceased_age_iso8601 is null. Case-1 'possible pre-excitation' is hedged; the checklist pre-excitation item was marked observed because the item includes 'short PR', which is stated. Case-1 learning-difficulty checklist item marked observed from special classes for reading and math. Case-3: 'no evidence of skeletal muscle weakness' recorded as excluded weakness, but muscle biopsy showed myopathy, so the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' was marked observed from the biopsy. Case-2 'short run of tachycardia (24 beats)' is of unstated type, so the SVT checklist item is not reported.
